description.value: Catelowna is a cat café on the second floor of a building in downtown Kelowna where visitors can enjoy organic, fair-trade coffee and tea while spending time with adoptable rescue cats. The café partners with local rescue organizations and has facilitated 548 cat adoptions to date. Beyond daily café visits, it hosts regular events including yoga sessions, paint-a-pet classes, and afternoon tea services.

address.value: Suite 201 - 1441 Ellis Street, Kelowna, BC V1Y 2A3

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website is fully accessible and corroborates all OSM contact fields (address Suite 201 - 1441 Ellis Street Kelowna BC V1Y 2A3, phone (236) 420-2011, email info@catelowna.com). OSM diet tags (vegan=yes, vegetarian=yes, gluten_free=yes) are supported by the website menu page which describes organic, plant-based, peanut-free ingredients and oat milk options. No mention of bike parking, washrooms, Wi-Fi, takeout, or water refills appears anywhere on the website or in OSM tags; OSM opening hours differ from those shown on the website footer.
concerns: OSM opening hours (Mo 11:00-16:00; Tu-Fr 11:00-18:00; Sa 10:00-17:00; Su 11:00-16:00) differ from website footer hours (Mon-Sat 10am-5:30pm, Sun 11am-4pm); website hours should be preferred.
Business is located on the 2nd floor of a building — street-level bike parking access is unconfirmed.
